text:
Priya K.: Quick headcount — partner wants a single "compatibility + sign-on" package that covers LangChain/LlamaIndex connectors -> Gateway adapter -> Redwood runtime, plus the marketplace contract language for trial SKUs. Need it by EOD Fri.
Owen D.: I'll produce a minimal "starter pack": manifest, metrics map, and a short runbook with fallback examples.
Marta S.: Marketing needs a one-line partner-friendly blurb and two hero image variants (light/dark). Also want approved phrasing for the marketplace: "in collaboration with" vs "powered by".
Ken (HW): From hardware side: share recommended profiles for H100 and A100; include quantization caveat that INT8 may change logits slightly. I'll attach sanitized numbers.
SI-Lead: For sign-on we need an explicit deploy manifest + an idempotent smoke test that CI can run. Also want the metric names to avoid collisions with our telemetry.
Todd (Marketplace): SKU rules reminder: <=60 chars, hyphens allowed, no slashes. Suggest pattern: "Gateway-Bridge-LangChain-Partner-Beta-[partner]". We can keep it partner-visible until conformance passes.
Elena (Legal): Co-mark copy ready. If partner requests "powered by" we need endorsement language + exec approval. Default copy: "integrated with Redwood Inference."
Priya K.: Here's the minimal checklist I'm proposing:
```
- Signed co-mark form for logos
- Starter manifest (K8s) + CI smoke test
- Perf bullets (H100/A100) + quantization note
- Metrics map (Prometheus names)
- Marketplace draft SKU + one-line blurb
- Partner rehearsal window + fallback verified
```
Owen D.: Sample manifest (public partner-friendly):
```
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: lc-gateway-adapter-starter
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: adapter
        image: redwood/gateway-adapter:partner-rc
        resources:
          limits:
            nvidia.com/gpu: 1
```
Owen D.: Fallback policy example we will include:
```
routing:
  - policy: prefer_gpu
    fallback: cpu_quantized
```
Marta S.: Proposed marketplace blurb: "Gateway Bridge for LangChain — partner trial. Integrated with Redwood Inference." Short and neutral. Thoughts?
SI-Lead: Blurb works. Please add a sentence about "trial limited to partner regions" if applicable.
Ken (HW): Benchmarks: H100 INT8 ~1.9x tokens/sec vs A100 INT8 on our reference workload. p95 lat sample attached.
Elena (Legal): Co-mark form sent to partner PM. Request logos as SVG + 2 PNGs. If we don't get signature by Wed EOD, we push partner preview one week.
Todd (Marketplace): I'll create a draft SKU in partner-drafts/176333 and hold publication until legal + assets + conformance green.
Priya K.: Timeline proposal: starter pack published Thu, partner rehearsal Mon, partner preview Tue, public beta Thu. Legal gating noted.
Owen D.: I'll add a tiny CI smoke script that hits /attach, /route, checks metrics, and exercises fallback. Will post link here.
Marta S.: Will prepare hero images and short copy. Blocking on co-mark wording from Elena.
SI-Lead: We'll schedule a 30-min arch sync after manifest posted. Also will run conformance CI and post results.
Ken (HW): Uploading sanitized perf artifact now.
Elena (Legal): Posting co-mark comments in the drive.
Todd (Marketplace): Draft SKU created; holding.
Priya K.: Action items recap:
- Owen: manifest + smoke CI + metrics map
- Ken: sanitized benchmarks
- Marta: blurb + hero images
- Elena: co-mark + logo form
- Todd: draft SKU + hold listing
- SI-Lead: run conformance CI + schedule arch sync
Priya K.: If any item slips, ping this thread. Locking provisional dates. End thread.
